query: Compare these already-collected sources: remove repeated URLs and count unique URLs per hostname. Return at most 2 unique items. Items: [{"url":"https://example.com/a#intro"},{"url":"https://example.com/a#results"},{"url":"https://other.org/b"}]. Do not search the web or fetch the pages.

metadata.what_it_tests: Route comparison of existing URLs to compare_sources rather than lookup, fetch, or format; preserve supplied URLs and explicit output limit.
